confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on several 2026 travel and cost-of-living sources, but most are travel blogs, some undated, and they mix island and national figures; Phu Quoc resort-area prices were adjusted upward from those figures. Wine is weakest: the only restaurant glass price found was a 2022 hotel menu (service charge and VAT excluded), so it was adjusted for inflation and checked against the beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and one undated blog's 4-star range; no booking pages or current listings were inspected, so the hostel and hotel figures are the least certain. The FX observation is the RBA figure for 15 October 2026 and is not used for any anchor here.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are anchored to Vietnamese national price levels (Bearsavings, Trek.zone, Passport and Stamps, Rising Sun Arts Centre) and Phu Quoc-specific menus and guides, with a resort-area uplift. Accommodation is a model estimate benchmarked loosely against Vietnamese beach resort towns such as Nha Trang and Da Nang and against Southeast Asian island resort destinations.
